about: Every module's PLACE: where it sits in the pipeline, whether it carries a compute contract, and what draws it. Declared here; `just places` computes the observed state against it and reports drift. Facts that live elsewhere are NOT copied here: a kernel's reads and writes belong to its ComputeContract, a stage's state to the route, a bar to the spec that declared it. TWO fields no check can read are `role` and `frame`, and both are marked as such rather than pretended otherwise: each is reported as a count, never as a pass. The rule both second readers reached independently on 2026-10-12 — declare a property only where a disagreement would sometimes be resolved by changing the CODE; a property whose disagreement is always resolved by editing the declaration is a fact and belongs to a computation, not to this file.

stage_fields.renders: the module in knee.pictures that draws this stage, or null if it has none. CHECKED: the named module must exist and be declared in the drawing layer. Only on a route stage's __init__.py.
stage_fields.frame: whether that picture arranges values computed from the STUDY or values about the PIPELINE's own state. NOT checkable, and counted. Fable, 2026-10-12: 'a stage is not built until it renders' cannot tell the two apart, so without this the route reports a stage as built while its purpose is unserved.

where.route:<stage>: runs inside the production route, in that stage of docs/OBJECT_MODEL.md
where.beside: cross-cutting or beside the route, per the object model's 'beside the route'
where.pictures: the drawing layer; a stage is not built until one of these renders it
where.workbench: second tier: probes and systems not yet production
where.script: a project verb, run by hand or by the justfile
where.shelf: exists, is not archived, and has no place in the settled route — a question, not a home. EMPTY since 2026-10-12: the five that sat here were archived at the founder's ruling rather than left as a standing question

src/knee/absence.py.role: the ONE shared vocabulary of silences every stage names an absence from — four silences whose remedies differ, plus `present` and `invalid_count` to keep the decision total; declared before any stage consumes it, because stages that coin their own codes pass their own tests and compose with nothing

src/knee/pipeline.py.role: the route itself: moves values between stages and decides nothing

src/knee/study/__init__.py.role: docstring only, no code: Figure 8's A MOVIE text, the founder's 2026-10-10 words on the 58, and what the stage hands on

src/knee/study/corpus.py.role: opens the corpus and reads one study whole at stored fidelity

src/knee/study/series.py.role: one series assembled from every .dcm in its directory, reordered along the slice normal, carrying named stack codes; returns a Series on BOTH paths, with volume and geometry None where it cannot stack

src/knee/study/slices.py.role: one DICOM file read whole: the header as stored minus Pixel Data, whose content becomes `pixels` at stored fidelity

src/knee/study/decoders.py.role: the six transfer syntaxes the competition's files need, each reported available or unavailable by name; `require_decoders` raises naming the missing and nothing falls back

src/knee/study/geometry.py.role: slice geometry in the patient's LPS frame from the tags as stored; every reader returns a named status with its values, naming WHICH zero it found (absent, empty, malformed, degenerate) rather than defaulting one

src/knee/study/tables.py.role: the competition's tables read as given, every cell a raw string and a blank kept as a blank, joined into studies with their series and the orphans kept; raises rather than guessing on a header mismatch, a duplicate study or a None cell

src/knee/study/shape.py.role: task 7.1a: the corpus's shape from the tables alone — studies and series per split, the view triples the labeled studies carry, the label codes per finding, the report column's presence and length — counted once when the corpus opens, written in the receipt and drawn; read by no decision

src/knee/collapse/__init__.py.role: the field: what a series IS before any expensive work runs

src/knee/collapse/regime.py.role: one series' regime key, read once from its own values and no label

src/knee/collapse/noise.py.role: the noise law, read two independent ways per series

src/knee/collapse/physical.py.role: the physical frame and the squint

src/knee/collapse/structure.py.role: task 7.1: the field's structural reading, which replaced the seam, structure and objects probes — air by connectivity to the border, the leg closed, the air histogram, the squint inside the leg, the superior–inferior axis from the header as a named code, the profile along it superior first with its dip, two basins seeded by the axis alone with the seam between them under the told sign, the darkest places and the largest bright bodies — every bar an argument with its provenance, every value retained, a member beside B1's interiors

src/knee/lenses/__init__.py.role: every place read in every acquisition, in one language

src/knee/lenses/digits.py.role: one place's named reading against supplied low/high edges, inclusive middle and distinct silences

src/knee/lenses/members.py.role: task 2.2a: what two SEATED MEMBERS said about one place — concur, dissent, one-only or neither-read — and deliberately no code meaning resolved, preferred or combined, because a disagreement between overlapping correct readings is the three-legged stool's informative case and its resolution is the founder's, never the pipeline's

src/knee/lenses/places.py.role: seats EVERY structurally warranted member and writes each one's native map against its OWN population's terciles — the noise-law cut and the background split, neither a fallback for the other — plus their standing per place; normalisation none, no anatomy, no cross-acquisition correspondence, and no field in which a winner could be recorded

src/knee/lenses/slab_kernels.py.role: task 7.10: the slab rule over arrays — a plain Python reference and its Numba twin, the same body compiled, each pinned element by element to the scalar `slab_code`, which stays the oracle; selected by the requested backend and never a silent fallback; the through-plane bank's kernel

src/knee/objects/__init__.py.role: docstring only, no code: declares the objects stage — what each module in it does, why it was split out of collapse, and that the residual pull-out is still owed

src/knee/objects/analysis.py.role: measures one series through the route: squint, interiors, boundary census

src/knee/objects/interiors.py.role: geometric interiors and observed dark borders, with no anatomical assignment

src/knee/objects/boundaries.py.role: what bounds each territory, and the relief between those that touch

src/knee/objects/conversation.py.role: the same-knee conversation between same-orientation readings

src/knee/objects/profiles.py.role: native profiles cast across a border, reference and JIT twin

src/knee/objects/band_raster.py.role: the convex sample-band supercover: which pixel cells a band touches, ties included, never extrapolated — a reference and its strict JIT twin, returning the mask and an exact visited count

src/knee/objects/border_codes.py.role: the pure named decision for a border reading

src/knee/objects/exchange_codes.py.role: the pure named decision for a boundary exchange

src/knee/objects/profile_codes.py.role: the pure named decision for profile support

src/knee/relations/__init__.py.role: interstices per facing pair, constructed and never detected

src/knee/relations/shell.py.role: task 1.3b: the stage RUNS and names the one unit it waits for — `construction_absent` for every input including a perfectly good one, because the silence is about the missing facing-pair construction (1.3a) and not about the study; an empty interstice tuple is silence and never a finding of 'no interstice'

src/knee/relations/pair_codes.py.role: the named decision for categorical support on both sides of an existing bracket; no anatomical identity

src/knee/relations/pairings.py.role: retains each profile's flanking native footprints, supported extent pair or named refusal; selected-plane sample support only

src/knee/ownership/__init__.py.role: every place claimed by one <object> or named unassigned — a partition, never an identification; its picture is the residual map, which is the channel the founder reads to supply the next lens

src/knee/ownership/claims.py.role: task 1.3: partitions one field into claimed, residual and unread places, reading the partition off interiors.labels and never asking what any <object> IS; a field that resolved NOTHING still returns its map, because then the residual is the whole field and that is the reading worth looking at

src/knee/predicates/__init__.py.role: the twelve findings, each a predicate on its subject

src/knee/predicates/findings.py.role: task 4.1: the twelve as named decisions, per STUDY, each abstaining with the structural requirement it did not receive — findings 2-11 because no relation is constructed, findings 0-1 because the predicate's form has not been given; it reads the RELATION between two extent indices and never asks what either IS, it writes no anatomical word in record or code, and it decides nothing because no expected correspondence has been declared

src/knee/output/__init__.py.role: twelve confidences per study, with the kept record behind them; its first increment is the companion record and the refused projection

src/knee/output/projection.py.role: task 6.8: the declared index-to-column correspondence, checked as a bijection onto the competition's labels; the companion record on every run; submission rows refused by name while the numeric projection is undeclared

src/knee/vectors/__init__.py.role: every place written in one language; an object's profile is the bundle of its places

src/knee/vectors/bundles.py.role: task 6.7: each indexed extent's profile as row counts over named banks — the lens members' codes and standing at its places, how it came out, and what every other acquisition's slabs measured of it by the slab rule — with every bank this build cannot write carried unavailable and never as zeros; keyed on the solitary parse's extents, one plane read

src/knee/memory/__init__.py.role: the memory and its buckets; recall arrives at diagnosis, not at the parse

src/knee/agencies/__init__.py.role: the four agencies, each marked where it acts

src/knee/record/__init__.py.role: the kept record of findings, where the agencies meet

src/knee/compute/__init__.py.role: the project-wide compute discipline below every stage: the ComputeContract each kernel carries, and handed_on, which freezes output storage so a consumer cannot write through a reading it was handed; defines nothing itself, re-exports three names

src/knee/compute/contracts.py.role: the ComputeContract itself, `contracted` (which attaches it as data, records the kernel in the registry `declared_contracts` reads, and returns the function unwrapped), and handed_on

src/knee/telemetry/__init__.py.role: where the compute went and what was recomputed: counted work, not wall time, in plain stdlib because this sits on the production import path and no profiler may reach a Kaggle kernel; off by default, defines nothing itself, re-exports four names

src/knee/telemetry/ledger.py.role: the ledger every stage records its work to

src/knee/pictures/__init__.py.role: the drawing layer, switchable off without the run noticing

src/knee/pictures/ownership.py.role: passes through ownership's claims, residual and named absence for the residual map without measuring or repairing them

src/knee/pictures/relations.py.role: passes through the relations shell's named construction absence for a frame about pipeline status

src/knee/pictures/pairings.py.role: passes through the pairing reading without deriving coordinates, identities or counts

src/knee/pictures/lenses.py.role: passes through the saved native-plane digit/code arrays and their edge metadata without selecting a plane or assigning anatomy

src/knee/pictures/predicates.py.role: passes through the twelve standings as the rows of one table — index, structural requirement, named code and reason — evaluating no predicate, selecting no subject and carrying no number, since a confidence is the output stage's lossy projection of this record

src/knee/pictures/output.py.role: passes through the output stage's companion record, its code, its projection (None while undeclared) and its refused submission rows unchanged, for a frame about pipeline state

src/knee/pictures/vectors.py.role: passes through every object's profile, bank by bank, as the stage returned it — an unavailable bank stays unavailable with its reason and no count is computed, summed or filled

workbench/measure/object_analysis.py.role: the real-entry-point analysis run, with its receipt

workbench/measure/machinery_facts.py.role: task 3.8a's run facts: what the object stage produces on one real study

workbench/measure/corpus_shape.py.role: the corpus's view structure from the tables alone, no pixel decode; prints, writes nothing

workbench/measure/geometry_spread.py.role: per-view geometry spread across the labeled studies, headers only; prints, writes nothing

workbench/measure/noise_floor.py.role: whether there is imaged air to measure sigma from and whether the intensity law looks Rician, over eight axial fat-suppressed series; prints, writes nothing

workbench/measure/object_toolkit_geometr.role: native spacing, tile width, superior projection and ordered-stack extent through Chapter 1's reader; WRITES data/measurements/object-toolkit-geometry.json, overwriting it

workbench/measure/regime_key.py.role: laterality, on-disk coverage, signedness and zero share per series, read one file per series; prints, writes nothing

workbench/measure/regime_run.py.role: the regime key over every series of the 58 through the real entry point, the first test of stages 1 and 2 on real data; prints aggregates, writes nothing

workbench/measure/reports.py.role: whether the report column exists, how long it is and whether it is machine-readable — not a reading of its content; prints, writes nothing

workbench/graph/object_measurements.py.role: the development-only Hamilton graph over the production functions

workbench/render/_out.py.role: the one place the workbench's pictures go: `pictures_dir()` resolves data/pictures project-relative from this file and creates it, so a picture lands in the same place from any working directory — and under data/, because a rendered knee is pixels and never enters git

workbench/render/axial.py.role: walks the axial stack through Z to show the space between the two bones, on up to two Axial fluid-sensitive series of at least 12 slices; writes data/pictures/axial.png

workbench/render/look.py.role: looks at four view/weighting combinations — the middle slice as recorded, what knee.collapse.noise's background split calls quiet, the histogram with that split marked, and the squint; writes data/pictures/look.png

workbench/render/objects.py.role: asks whether the femur and tibia are THERE as two bodies with a space where they meet, on both weightings of one Coronal study because the marrow's sign flips between them while cortex is signal-void on both; writes data/pictures/objects.png

workbench/render/object_boundaries.py.role: draws the boundary census: what bounds each territory and the relief between neighbours

workbench/render/object_conversation.py.role: draws the B2 conversation across saved acquired views

workbench/render/object_interiors.py.role: draws the B1 interiors and native traces

workbench/render/object_packet.py.role: renders a source-linked image series from a SAVED Packet A run: per-view panels, series.png and a manifest binding the receipt, the loaded arrays, this renderer and its sibling by digest; writes only under its --out

workbench/render/object_profiles.py.role: draws one saved production measurement record and computes no substitute segmentation — `draw_record` only ARRANGES the saved values and their explicit colour annotations, and does no file I/O; object_packet calls it for both its gallery axis and its per-record figure

workbench/render/partition_frames.py.role: draws the saved ownership masks and relations construction status through their picture modules, verifying mask descriptors and binding the gallery to its receipt

workbench/render/all_frames.py.role: task 4b.2: draws EVERY stage of one saved run in one pass and indexes what was drawn — imports each renderer lazily and calls its draw(), so a run with pictures off loads no Matplotlib; a renderer that raises is recorded as not_drawn with its reason and the rest still draw, and every route stage is named whether or not a drawer covers it

workbench/render/predicate_frames.py.role: draws the saved twelve-row predicate table through the predicates picture module, checking every saved code against the stage's own vocabulary and that each reason still names its requirement before drawing; writes no number against any finding and binds the image to its receipt

workbench/render/pair_frames.py.role: arranges saved profile coordinates and categorical pairing outcomes, binding the gallery to its receipt and validated arrays

workbench/render/lens_frames.py.role: draws saved native-plane digit maps with silence distinct from middle, validating representation and content digests before passing arrays through the lens picture adapter

workbench/render/field_frames.py.role: task 6.9: draws the field stage's saved squint maps and the whole saved regime key per series through knee.pictures.collapse.field_panels, keeping a tile not read, a reading not made, a regime unreadable and a value not saved as four distinct silences; measures nothing

workbench/render/study_frames.py.role: task 6.9: draws the study stage's saved plane with the geometry the record states through knee.pictures.study.recorded_panels, labelling each value with the stage that produced it; the stack walk is owed by the writer and the manifest says so

workbench/render/output_frames.py.role: task 6.9: draws the output stage's companion record from one saved study entry through knee.pictures.output, refusing a record whose codes, columns, projection or submission rows disagree with the stage's own vocabulary; writes no number the stage did not save

workbench/render/bundle_frames.py.role: task 6.7: draws each object's profile as one table of banks and counts per object from the saved vectors record through knee.pictures.vectors, an unavailable bank drawn grey with its reason and no count cells; refuses a record that disagrees with the stage's vocabulary

workbench/render/seam.py.role: the two objects and the seam between them, with the three corrections its docstring names: the leg CLOSED by filling its holes, the superior-inferior axis read from the header and never assumed to be image rows, and the seam found as a relation between two watershed basins rather than a dark band hunted by intensity; writes data/pictures/seam.png

workbench/render/structure.py.role: air defined by CONNECTIVITY to the frame's edge rather than by a threshold, then whether the joint line survives the squint and where the population of studies disagrees, over three views; writes data/pictures/structure.png

scripts/places.py.role: computes every module's observed place against this file, and reports the drift

scripts/unit_loop.py.role: prints the build loop with the route's live state

scripts/composition_check.py.role: task 7.4: reads a real run's receipt and says whether its stages composed — every `produced` consumed, no phantom consumer, the conversation before ownership — from the ledger and never from the artifact; advisory, run after every real run

scripts/object_graph.py.role: the dependency graph over the production route; a value nothing consumes shows as dangling

scripts/object_status.py.role: recomputes a saved packet's source standing

scripts/detective_resolution.py.role: proves Detective and Wesker resolve to the local checkouts

scripts/verify_profiles_same.py.role: SAME between reference and twin for Packet A

scripts/verify_conversation_visuals.py.role: binds the staged photos to their receipt
